description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon and day length at a place on a day (today by default), with how much longer or shorter the day is than the day before, civil, nautical and astronomical twilight, and the golden and blue hours for photos. Local clock time, to the minute.

city.description: One of the site's places by name, e.g. "Kraków", "Zakopane", "Hel", "London" (find_city lists them)

lang.description: Language of the answer: pl (default) or en

tz.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw (with lat and lon)

name: sun_times
title: Sunrise and sunset
